name: Mark VI patrol boat (Safe Boats International), US Navy, from 2016

published.source: Wikipedia infobox / Navy fact file: 84.8 ft x 20.5 ft, draft 4 ft (us_mk6_patrol.js header)

must_show: a hard-chine planing hull 25.9 m overall, raked stem to the stem head at x +12.95, flat transom at x -12.65 with the two waterjet nozzles reaching x -12.95 [180207-N-AT895-068 broadside]
a waist-high bulwark round the whole weather deck, top at z 2.00, the deck recessed at z 1.25 [Kater-mark-VI; broadside]
the low aft house x -4.75 .. -0.95, roof z 3.40, four ribbon windows a side [broadside]
the pilothouse x -0.95 .. +8.35, roof z 3.80, three raked windscreen panes with corner panes, foot at x 8.30 [bow-on photographs]
the mast pylon swept aft off the pilothouse roof, base x -0.2 .. +1.4, the radome ball at z 5.95, and the open T-top frame ahead of it with radar and EO ball, whip tips to z 7.25 [broadside]
TWO Mk 38 Mod 2 25 mm mounts: the forward one the trained 'turret' node, ring at x +10.25, z 2.20; the aft one at x -7.35, z 2.15 trained aft [broadside]

six M2 .50 cal on pintle cradles with their ammunition cans: two on the pilothouse roof (x -0.45), two on the foredeck flanking the windscreen (x 8.85), two on the bulwark amidships (x 3.0) [bow-on; broadside]
guard rails on the foredeck and the side decks, cleats and fairleads on the bulwark cap, the bow roller and anchor at x 12.55; plain haze grey, no hull number [broadside; bow-on]
